clauses.evidence: E07-S01#AC8, S03#AC4 (advice-side only: check, never fold, when no bet faces; action bar itself is E03)
E07-S11#AC1-3 (rule thresholds not given as numbers, see finding)
E07-S10#AC1 (calling range = Strong+Pair+Draw, includes raising hands, worked example)
E07-S07#AC3-6 (worked fixture independently checked: classes and narrowed sets are correct)
DoD 'text is original' on E07-S01, S05, S07, S12, S14 (TASK-7.11), S15 (TASK-7.14); matches the requirement's own fit criterion
E07-S13#AC1 (--check-advice option; other options are E01)

findings.evidence: TASK-7.9 ACs say 'the documented implied-odds rule is met / not met' but give no pot, bet, equity or outs numbers and the story states no rule threshold; an implementer must invent the rule to write the test. Compare S10, which has worked exact values.
findings.fix: Add a worked example: flop with an open-ended straight draw, stated pot, bet, equity and required equity, and the exact rule outcome (call with 8 outs / fold), plus a boundary pair.

findings.evidence: Notes say grade results carry the short-stack note for the review entry, but no AC checks it (S16#AC4 does the equivalent for the approximate label) and S17 does not depend on the grader TASK-7.4.
findings.fix: Add an AC: graded SNG decision at 9 big bets, grade result carries the same short-stack sentence; add E07-S04 to deps.

findings.evidence: Position mapping for non-reference sizes (3-handed, 4, 5, 7, 8) is left as a 'design choice to document'; AC4 checks only which chart is chosen, not which position cell is used, so the mapping is not pass/fail.
findings.fix: Add one AC with a concrete mapping example, e.g. a 5-handed cutoff-seat decision uses the stated 6-max position cell.

findings.evidence: AC1 validates every situation 'that applies' to each position without listing which (position, situation) pairs apply, so completeness cannot be checked mechanically.
findings.fix: List the applicable pairs in the story or require them as data in the chart schema.

findings.evidence: AC8 tags REQ-017.1, which is about the action bar; the AC only proves advice returns check. Harmless because E03 owns the clause, but the AC would pass without the action bar behaviour.
findings.fix: Keep the AC but drop the REQ-017.1 tag, or note it as the advice-side confirmation only.

findings.evidence: Description says with several opponents equity is computed against each opponent's calling range, but no AC exercises a multiway value decision; precedence between value-bet and implied-odds rules is also unstated.
findings.fix: Add a two-opponent value-bet AC with exact equity, and state rule precedence in the design document.

findings.evidence: 'facing a $4 bet with $20 in the pot (required equity 4/24)' is ambiguous about whether the $20 includes the bet; the arithmetic holds only if it does.
Description says the scaled range is never narrower than the single strongest hand class, but no AC tests it.
findings.fix: Add an AC with a scaled width of 0% giving one hand class.

summary: All round-1 findings are resolved: missing deps on the grader added (S13, S15, S16), S04 uses injected fixtures, the calling range is defined with a worked example (S10#AC1, equities independently recomputed: 72.8%, 48.9%, 60.7%), narrowing ACs are exact and correct, fourth-bet charts are tested at all three sizes, S08 is now an explicit enabler, S09 AC5 has numbers, S14 is split into preflop and postflop suites. All 56 clauses are covered. Remaining items are one MEDIUM (implied-odds ACs lack worked values) and minor LOW items. No CRITICAL or HIGH.
